definitions.grasp_success_rate: grasp attempts (gripper close commands on a target) whose target object was lifted
definitions.pick_rate: objects placed in the bin / objects that entered the conveyor
definitions.injected latency: sum of fixed T1 + detection + T4 + T5 latencies on the camera-to-grasp chain
definitions.measured_camera_to_grasp_p50_ms: median of frame capture to first actuator command using the resulting plan; includes sampling waits for T6 (5 ms) and T4 (125 ms)
definitions.tolerance_ms: largest swept latency before success first drops below 0.9 x baseline
definitions.monotonic_within_noise: no step increases by more than the larger 95 % CI half-width

assumptions.policy: scripted expert in hybrid mode (VLA compute is modeled separately from its operator graph)
assumptions.controller: computed-torque joint impedance, wn 40 rad/s, 1 kHz
